title: Core-accepted settings keys (_cssid injected by get_props_schema()) pass the settings-key truthfulness gate
_comment: COMPANION fixture to e-heading.unknown-settings-key (1.7.x settings-key gate): the allowlist is DERIVED from the element's props schema, and has-atomic-base.php::get_props_schema() injects '_cssid' when the element doesn't declare it — so _cssid (and every declared key: classes/tag/title here) must sail through the gate. Guards against an over-eager gate that hard-errors core's own keys. VERIFIED valid:true via the companion dry_run REST route on Elementor 4.2.1 free (playground :8947, 2026-08-12). prefilter.verdict:defer — schema-key membership is a PHP-authority decision.
